source: 刘晓燕《四级你还在背单词吗》
title: The Man Who Quit His Phone
tts_text: Liu Wei worked in a factory that manufactured locks. Its old machine had a defect, and the payroll had not risen for two years. Every night he would indulge in short videos until two in the morning. He was addicted to his phone, and his mind wandered all day. He could not concentrate, and his wife would contradict him. He could not deny that she was right. His eyes hurt, and the doctor said the abuse of his sleep would affect his heart. The effect was easy to predict: he fell asleep at his desk and his pay slip indicated a fine. He showed less affection at home, and a habit like that can infect a whole family. A friend of his had gone through a divorce for the same reason. Then his wife became pregnant. One Monday he walked into the Riverside Community Centre. A receptionist asked him to register at the front desk. He wrote his name in the entry book, and she handed him a receipt. He was the first recipient of the new card. The card entitled him to three free cups of tea and a talk with a doctor. The centre was recruiting new members for the autumn term. The course quality was good and the fee was low. The facility had a quiet room and a long garden path. He paid for the first month and enrolled the same evening. On his first morning he took a stroll along the river and did not wander far from the centre. At ten a trolley came down the corridor with tea and biscuits. By the third week he could sit for an hour without his phone.

sentences_cn: 刘伟在一家制造锁具的工厂上班。
厂里那台老机器有个缺陷，工资单上的数字也两年没涨了。
每天晚上，他都沉溺在短视频里，看到凌晨两点。
他对手机上瘾，白天心思总是飘走。
他集中不了精神，妻子为此常跟他抬杠。
他没法否认她说得对。
他的眼睛开始疼，医生说这样滥用睡眠会影响他的心脏。
后果不难预言：他趴在桌上睡着了，工资条上写明了一笔罚款。
他在家里表现出的感情越来越少，而这样的坏习惯会传染一整个家庭。
他的一个朋友就是因为同样的原因离了婚。
后来，妻子怀孕了。
一个星期一，他走进了滨河社区中心。
一位接待员请他在前台登记。
他把名字写进登记簿，她递给他一张收据。
他是新会员卡的第一位领取者。
这张卡让他有权免费喝三杯茶，还能和医生谈一次。
中心正在为秋季班招募新成员。
课程质量不错，费用也低。
这里的设施有一间安静的房间和一条长长的花园小径。
他付了第一个月的钱，当天晚上就报了名。
第一个早晨，他沿着河边散了会儿步，没走出中心太远。
十点钟，一辆手推车沿着走廊推过来，上面是茶和饼干。
到第三周，他已经能一个小时不碰手机了。

words.cn: 滥用，妄用；虐待；辱骂；诋毁
words.mnemonic: ab前缀表否定，那这个单词 是：不正常的使用(use)，就是“滥用”。
words.zhenti: That may lead to nursing home abuse and age discrimination. 那可能会导致养老院虐 待和年龄歧视。
words.sentence: the abuse of his sleep would affect his heart
words.root: ab(偏离) + use(使用) → 不正常地用 → 滥用；虐待
words.family: abusive adj. 辱骂的，虐待的

words.mnemonic: 该单词发音类似“万达(广场)”。 周末没事，去万达“闲逛”。
words.zhenti: No longer have we the inclination to let ourselves wander through fields of knowledges, ready to be surprised. 我们不再倾向于让自己在 知识的领域中漫游，准备好接受惊喜。(2017)
words.sentence: his mind wandered all day
words.root: 谐音「万达」→ 周末没事去万达闲逛 → 漫游；走神
words.family: wanderer n. 漫游者

words.mnemonic: 在街上(st 想成 street)滚(roll) 一圈→散步，漫步。
words.zhenti: You can stroll along the beach if you live in the hotel. 如果你住在这家旅馆里，你可以沿 着海滩散步。
words.sentence: he took a stroll along the river
words.root: 联想：st(街) + roll(滚) → 在街上慢悠悠地转 → 散步
words.family: stroll n. 散步，漫步

words.cn: 招生；吸收成员;注册课程
words.mnemonic: 使(en)滚进来(roll 滚，rock and roll摇滚），使你滚进我们的机构或组织，就是 “吸收成员”。
words.zhenti: But after being enrolled in an online course last fall semester, I came to realize online classes were merely a means to fulfil course requirements. 但在去年秋季学期注册了 一门网络课程后，我意识到网络课程只是满足 课程要求的一种手段。(2021)
words.sentence: enrolled the same evening
words.root: en(使进入) + roll(名单) → 把名字写进名单 → 注册
words.family: enrollment n. 注册，招生

words.zhenti: The only industries swelling their payrolls are health care, utilities and the federal government.只有医疗保健、公用事业 和联邦政府这几个行业的工资在增加。
words.sentence: The payroll had not risen for two years
words.root: pay(工资) + roll(名单) → 发工资的名单 → 工资总额
words.family: pay v. 支付 / payment n. 付款

words.mnemonic: t想成“他”，roll 滚动，ey名词 后缀。联想成：他推着超市的“手推车”，轮子在 滚动。
words.sentence: At ten a trolley came down the corridor
words.root: 联想：t(他) + roll(滚) + ey → 他推着轮子滚动的小车
words.family: trolleybus n. 无轨电车

words.cn: 吸收(新成员);劝说 n7. 新成员
words.mnemonic: re(重新，又一次)+cruit(发音 类似 crude，粗糙的)；又一批粗糙的成员(需要 打磨），就是那些“新成员”，“吸收”新兵。
words.zhenti: New teachers and staff have to be recruited. 必须招聘新的教师和工作人员。(2022)
words.sentence: The centre was recruiting new members for the autumn term
words.root: re(再) + cruit(生长) → 让队伍再长起来 → 招募
words.family: recruitment n. 招募 / recruiter n. 招聘者

words.mnemonic: title n. 标题(我们开发票时，老 板问抬头开什么？抬头就是“标题”)；en(使)十 title(标题)→使……有标题。使你有个标题(行 头)就可以做事了，所以这个单词的意思就是 “给……权利或资格”。 第四单元
words.zhenti: Students read and discussed an article entitled "You Can Grow Your Brain".学生们 阅读并讨论了一篇题为“你可以发展你的大脑” 的文章。(2016)
words.sentence: The card entitled him to three free cups of tea
words.root: en(使) + title(名分) → 使有名分 → 给……权利或资格
words.family: entitlement n. 权利，资格

words.sentence: The course quality was good
words.root: qual(什么样的) + ity(名词) → 是什么样 → 品质，质量
words.family: qualify v. 使合格 / qualitative adj. 定性的

words.mnemonic: 它的动词形式我们很熟悉， receive 意为“接收”，那 receipt的意思就很简单 了→收据。
words.zhenti: You may have to pay all you medical expenses and then later submit your receipts to the insurance company. 你可能需要支付所有 的医疗费用，然后提交收据给保险公司。
words.sentence: she handed him a receipt
words.root: re(回) + ceipt(=ceive 拿) → 拿到手的凭据 → 收据
words.family: receive v. 收到 / receiver n. 接收器

words.mnemonic: 该单词来自receive（接收）， recipient 是它的名词形式→受方；接受者。
words.zhenti: Americans routinely overestimate the share of black recipients of public assistance programs. 美国人经常高估公共援助计划中黑 人受益者的比例。
words.sentence: He was the first recipient of the new card
words.root: re(回) + cip(拿) + ient(人) → 拿到东西的人 → 接受者
words.family: receive v. 收到 / receipt n. 收据

words.mnemonic: reception 源于 receive(接受)， (103) ist表示人，那这个单词就是：接收你的人→接 待员。
words.zhenti: It is important that the hotel receptionist make sure that guests are registered correctly. 酒店接待员确保客人登记正确是很重要的。
words.sentence: A receptionist asked him to register at the front desk
words.root: reception(接待) + ist(人) → 负责接待的人 → 接待员
words.family: reception n. 接待处 / receive v. 接收

words.cn: 登记；注册；注意到η. 登记表，注册簿
words.mnemonic: 重复的(re)哥哥（g)姐姐(ister 费和( 婚了，后来又“登记”复婚了。
words.zhenti: Activities like knitting and crocheting make it harder for the brain to register pain signals. 像编织和钩针编织这样的活动使大脑 更难注意到疼痛信号。(2017)
words.sentence: asked him to register at the front desk
words.root: re(再) + gister(记录) → 再记一遍 → 登记，注册
words.family: registration n. 登记 / registered adj. 已注册的

words.mnemonic: 这个单词的动词是 enter(进 入），我们很熟悉。那名词 entry就是“人口处； 进人”的意思。
words.zhenti: The wide majority of the rest were illegal, unforced entries that resulted from something like a· window being left open. 其余 的绝大多数都是非法的、非强制的进入，这是由 于窗户被打开之类的原因造成的。(2016)
words.sentence: He wrote his name in the entry book
words.root: enter(进入) 的名词 → 进入；入口；登记的一笔
words.family: enter v. 进入 / entrance n. 入口

words.cn: 怀孕的，妊娠的；意义重大的
words.zhenti: Pregnant employees struggled to keep up. 怀孕的员工努力跟上进度。
words.sentence: Then his wife became pregnant
words.root: pre(之前) + gn(生) + ant → 生产之前的 → 怀孕的
words.family: pregnancy n. 怀孕

words.mnemonic: 这个单词的发音类似：敌我死。 当夫妻俩过着敌死我活的生活时，他们就要“离 婚”了。
words.zhenti: The divorce rate in the county has been on a steady rise. 这个县的离婚率一直在稳步上 升。(2023)
words.sentence: had gone through a divorce for the same reason
words.root: di(分开) + vorce(转) → 两人各自转向 → 离婚
words.family: divorced adj. 离了婚的

words.cn: 集中，专心于 η. 浓缩物
words.mnemonic: 所有人(con)以……为中心（把 centra 想成 centre，中心)，ate 是动词后缀，那就 是所有人都以一个东西为中心，比如以大雁为 中心，那就是大家都在“专心于”大雁。
words.zhenti: When the author was a college student, she found that knitting helped her concentrate. 当作者还是一名大学生时，她发现编织有助于 自己集中注意力。(2017)
words.sentence: He could not concentrate
words.root: con(共同) + centr(中心) + ate → 都聚到一个中心 → 集中
words.family: concentration n. 专注 / concentrated adj. 浓缩的

words.mnemonic: in表示“里面”，dul 发音类似 “读了”，ge发音类似“哥”，连在一起就是：哥哥 在家里每天读书。这不就是哥哥每天“沉溺于” 读书吗？
words.sentence: would indulge in short videos until two in the morning
words.root: 联想：in(里) + dul(读) + ge(哥) → 哥哥在家天天读书，沉溺其中
words.family: indulgence n. 放纵 / indulgent adj. 纵容的

words.cn: 使成瘾，使入迷n. 入迷的人，成瘾的人
words.mnemonic: dict= dic(= say)，表示“说话， 断言”；一再地(ad)说(dict)。祥林嫂一再地说 她的阿毛死了，已经入迷了啊→使入迷。
words.zhenti: You can't be addicted to the environment. 你不能沉迷于这个环境。(2010)
words.sentence: He was addicted to his phone
words.root: ad(一再) + dict(说) → 一再念叨停不下来 → 使成瘾
words.family: addiction n. 瘾 / addictive adj. 使人上瘾的

words.mnemonic: contradict(反驳)十ory(形容词 后缀)→对立的。
words.sentence: his wife would contradict him
words.root: contra(相反) + dict(说) → 说反话 → 反驳，否认
words.family: contradiction n. 矛盾 / contradictory adj. 对立的

words.mnemonic: 该单词发音类似：抵赖。抵赖 不就是“否认”吗？
words.zhenti: There is no denying that mobile phones have brought much convenience. 不可否认，手 机带来了很多便利。
words.sentence: He could not deny that she was right
words.root: 谐音「抵赖」→ 抵赖就是否认 → 否认；拒绝
words.family: denial n. 否认

words.mnemonic: pre(在前的)十dict(说)→预先 说→预言。
words.zhenti: In other words, when it comes to cities— or anything else—it is hard to predict the future.换句话说，当提到城市或其他任何事物 时，很难预测未来。(2019)
words.sentence: The effect was easy to predict
words.root: pre(在前) + dict(说) → 预先说 → 预言，预测
words.family: prediction n. 预测 / predictable adj. 可预测的

words.mnemonic: in(进入)十 dic(说)十ate(动词 后级)→在里面说，没有明示→暗示；表明。 (105) 第四单元
words.zhenti: The saying indicates the importance of lifelong learning, which we have been lectured over and over again. 这句话表明了终身学习的 重要性，这一点我们已经被说教过很多次了。
words.sentence: his pay slip indicated a fine
words.root: in(向) + dic(说) + ate → 用迹象说话 → 表明，暗示
words.family: indication n. 迹象 / indicator n. 指示器

words.mnemonic: 词根 fac等同于 fact，表示 “做”。fact的意思是“实际上”，什么是实际的？ 嘴上“说”不算实际的，“做”才是实际的，可以让 我们“做”(fac)东西或事情的就是“设施，设备”。
words.zhenti: What kind of care facility old people live in may be less important than we think. 老年 人住在什么样的护理机构可能没有我们想象的 那么重要。(2016)
words.sentence: The facility had a quiet room
words.root: fac(做) + ility → 供人做事的条件 → 设施，设备
words.family: facilitate v. 促进 / facilities n. 设施(复数)

words.mnemonic: de看成弟弟，fect 词根等同于 fact，表示“做”，弟弟做事，做得好吗？不好啊， 那么该单词就是“缺点，缺陷”的意思。
words.sentence: Its old machine had a defect
words.root: de(向下、不好) + fect(做) → 没做好 → 缺点，缺陷
words.family: defective adj. 有缺陷的

words.zhenti: Such personality characteristics as self- discipline have no effect on longevity. 自律等这 些人格特征对长寿没有影响。(2016)
words.sentence: The effect was easy to predict
words.root: ef(=ex 出) + fect(做) → 做出来的结果 → 效果，影响
words.family: effective adj. 有效的 / effectively adv. 有效地

words.zhenti: Mothers' negative personality characteristics may affect their children's lifespans. 母亲的消极 人格特征可能会影响孩子的寿命。(2016)
words.sentence: would affect his heart
words.root: af(=ad 去) + fect(做) → 对……动了手脚 → 影响
words.family: affection n. 感情 / affected adj. 受影响的

words.cn: 感情；影响；喜爱，钟爱；爱情
words.mnemonic: affect影响，ion是名词后缀。 别人的行为或语言最容易对你产生什么影响？ →感情；喜爱；钟爱。
words.zhenti: People of different ages and genders show affection in different ways. 不同年龄、不 同性别的人以不同的方式表达感情。
words.sentence: He showed less affection at home
words.root: affect(影响) + ion(名词) → 能打动心里的东西 → 感情
words.family: affectionate adj. 深情的

words.cn: 传染；使感染；使携带病菌
words.zhenti: Two million bees were infected with disease. 200万只蜜蜂感染了疾病。
words.sentence: can infect a whole family
words.root: in(进入) + fect(做) → 病菌进来作乱 → 传染，感染
words.family: infection n. 感染 / infectious adj. 传染性的

words.cn: (用机器)大量生产，成批制造 η. 大量制 造；批量生产 adj.完美的；完全的;最佳的 v. 使完善；使完 美；使完备
words.mnemonic: manufacture 前面部分是 man 人，fact做(做的才是实际的)。工业革命以前 生产的东西都是手工的啊，所以该单词就是人 做，那就是“生产，制造”。
words.zhenti: Great achievement only belongs to those who can do small things perfectly. 伟大的成就 只属于那些能把小事做到完美的人。
words.sentence: a factory that manufactured locks
words.root: manu(手) + fact(做) + ure → 用手做 → 制造，生产
words.family: manufacturer n. 制造商
